description:
Implement NameConstraints extension processing per RFC 5280 §4.2.1.10 and the §6.1.4(b) / §6.1.5(b) state machine steps.

Spec references:
- RFC 5280 §4.2.1.10 — NameConstraints extension structure (permittedSubtrees, excludedSubtrees)
- RFC 5280 §6.1.4(b) — per-certificate NameConstraints processing in the path validation algorithm
- RFC 5280 §6.1.5(b) — final NameConstraints check
- RFC 5280 §7 — internationalized names (DNSName, RFC 822 email, URI, IP, directoryName)
- RFC 4518 — DN string normalization (prerequisite; file as blocking issue)
- PKITS section 4.13 — ~40 test vectors covering name constraint cases
title: Name constraints (RFC 5280 §4.2.1.10)
